lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Wallis and Futuna Islands using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset includes approximately 8,200 building polygons with structural attributes (levels, materials) and address information, with AI-based completeness estimates indicating ~100% coverage of the region.
